note: ADR 1031: a getter (a component element's children or a prop's value) whose every read in the project component is in intrinsic JSX, in the body or in a `children()` helper, with the props object kept, runs under the component's render owner: `<Inner />` in ByJsx, ByBody, ByHelper and BySlot creates with an owner and raises nothing (the checker is silent there now, `getter-runs-where-read` before); ByApply (PRIMITIVE_IN_EFFECT_CALLBACK) and ByLeaf (PRIMITIVE_IN_FORBIDDEN_SCOPE) read it where it throws and stay covered by uncertifiable rows, as do the other unplaced getters
